scope: Second40 only; previous40 and trial4 excluded; NEEDS_REVIEW74/custom13 excluded

selection.name: 덤벨 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on a flat bench, feet on floor, pressing one dumbbell in each hand upward from chest level.

selection.name: 친업
selection.pose_description: Pull-up with UNDERHAND palms-facing-body grip, chin above horizontal bar, feet off floor.

selection.name: 덤벨 리스트 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated with forearms supported on thighs, only wrists curling load upward. Palms up. Use equipment: two dumbbells, bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 맨몸 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Bodyweight squat without weights, both feet planted shoulder-width, bending knees and hips with arms extended forward.

selection.name: 인클라인 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on an inclined bench about 35 degrees, both feet on floor, lowering a BARBELL to upper chest; barbell remains above chest, not behind neck. Side three-quarter view.

selection.name: 슈퍼맨 로우
selection.pose_description: Prone on floor with chest slightly raised, arms bent to pull elbows toward ribs, no weights. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 벤치 딥스
selection.pose_description: Hands on edge of a bench behind hips, feet on floor in front, lowering hips in front of bench by bending elbows.

selection.name: 데드버그
selection.pose_description: Lying on back, one arm extending overhead and opposite leg extending low above floor while other hip and knee remain bent.

selection.name: 인클라인 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Hands elevated on a bench, toes on floor, straight body sloping upward toward shoulders. Use equipment: bench, floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 벤트오버 덤벨 레터럴 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Hips hinged forward, raising both arms sideways. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 시티드 덤벨 트라이셉 익스텐션
selection.pose_description: Seated on upright bench, upper arms overhead, extending elbows to raise load. Use equipment: two dumbbells, upright bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 걷기
selection.pose_description: Walking on level ground, one foot in contact with floor, upright body and relaxed alternating arm swing; no treadmill.

selection.name: 스탠딩 케이블 플라이
selection.pose_description: Standing between two cable columns, holding one handle in each hand, bringing arms together in front of chest at chest height.

selection.name: 바벨 슈러그
selection.pose_description: Standing with arms straight down holding load, elevating shoulders toward ears without bending elbows. Use equipment: barbell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 이지바 컬
selection.pose_description: Standing, elbows beside ribs, bending elbows to curl load upward. Palms face upward. Use equipment: EZ curl bar. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 런지
selection.pose_description: Split stance, lowering rear knee toward floor with front foot planted. Step forward into the lunge. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 바벨 플로어 프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on FLOOR with bent knees, pressing load over chest; elbows stop against floor, no bench. Use equipment: barbell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 Y 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing torso hinged forward, arms raised diagonally overhead to form a Y, light dumbbell each hand.

selection.name: 리버스 덤벨 리스트 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated with forearms supported on thighs, only wrists curling load upward. Palms down, wrists extending upward. Use equipment: two dumbbells, bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 버드독
selection.pose_description: On hands and knees extending one arm forward and opposite leg backward parallel to floor, neutral back.

selection.name: 와이드 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Floor push-up with palms visibly wider than shoulder width, toes on floor, straight body, elbows bent. Front three-quarter view emphasizing the wide hand spacing.

selection.name: 레터럴 레이즈 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated in lateral raise machine, upper arms against elbow pads, raising arms sideways toward shoulder height.

selection.name: 컨센트레이션 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated leaning forward, working upper arm braced against inner thigh, curling ONE dumbbell toward shoulder.

selection.name: 루마니안 데드리프트
selection.pose_description: Standing holding barbell, slight knee bend, hips hinge backward lowering bar close to legs without resting on floor.

selection.name: 숄더 탭
selection.pose_description: High plank on palms and toes, one hand lifts to touch opposite shoulder while torso remains stable.

selection.name: 악력기
selection.pose_description: One hand squeezing a spring hand gripper between palm and fingers; show entire athlete and close clear gripper at chest height.

selection.name: 힙 어덕션 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated in adductor machine, pads against INNER knees, moving thighs inward together.

selection.name: 레그 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Lying on back on floor, both straight legs raised toward vertical, pelvis controlled, no hanging bar.

selection.name: 파이크 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Palms and toes on floor, hips raised in an inverted V, elbows bending to lower head between hands.

selection.name: 케틀벨 스윙
selection.pose_description: Standing, hips hinging then extending to swing ONE kettlebell with both hands to chest height; arms do not lift overhead.

selection.name: 힙 어브덕션 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated in abductor machine, pads against OUTER knees, opening thighs outward.

selection.name: 덤벨 사이드 벤드
selection.pose_description: Standing upright, holding resistance in one hand at side, bending torso sideways without rotating. Use equipment: one dumbbell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케이블 프론트 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing, raising load FORWARD to shoulder height with softly bent elbows. Load connected to low pulley. Use equipment: cable machine. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케이블 로프 푸시 다운
selection.pose_description: Standing facing HIGH cable, elbows fixed at sides, extending elbows to push attachment downward. Use equipment: high cable machine, rope attachment. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 박스 점프
selection.pose_description: Jumping with both feet toward top of stable box, knees flexed and arms swinging for balance.

selection.name: 월 싯
selection.pose_description: Back against a vertical wall, knees and hips bent about 90 degrees, thighs horizontal and feet planted.

selection.name: 핸드스탠드
selection.pose_description: Inverted handstand with both palms on floor, arms straight, legs together vertically overhead.

selection.name: 시티드 카프 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Seated at seated calf machine, knees bent90 degrees and thigh pad above knees, raising heels from foot platform.

selection.name: 덤벨 고블릿 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Both feet planted, bending knees and hips with neutral spine. One weight held with both hands at chest. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 리버스 크런치
selection.pose_description: Lying on back with knees bent, curling pelvis off support toward chest. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.
